text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for model/redwood-7B v2.4.1 -> canary-3. deploy id dpl-20260315-9f3b. :rotating_light: monitor: 10% traffic
alex: Getting paged — some canary requests returning garbled tokens, looks like tokenizer mismatch. Examples attached.
alex: ```
input: "Generate a short product blurb for 'Nimbus'"
output: "ĠGenerate Ġa Ġshort Ġproduct Ġblurb Ġfor Ġ'Ni\u0000mbus' \u001F..."
``` 
alex: Also seeing increased tokenization errors in logs: tokenizer.err.count spikes +1500 in last 3 min
incident-bot: Pager escalated to on-call (maria). Incident ID INC-20260315-87. Severity: P1. Link: https://redwood/incident/INC-20260315-87
maria: I'm on it. Acknowledging. Can you paste the deploy manifest and checksum of weights?
alex: Here — deploy manifest snippet
```
model: redwood-7B
weights_uri: s3://redwood-models/redwood-7b/v2.4.1/weights.tar.gz
weights_sha256: 7f3a9c2b...f12
tokenizer: redwood-tokenizer-v1.2
```
alex: The previous stable deploy v2.4.0 had tokenizer v1.1 and weights_sha256 6b2e1a...aa9
maria: If tokenizer version changed in this rollout that's probably the root cause (tokenization mismatch + decoding errors). We need quick mitigation: toggle feature flag to stop routing traffic to new weights and restore routing to v2.4.0. I'll try the kill-switch for canary pool first.
maria: Runbook command:
```
# disable new-weights for canary pool
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/featureflags -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"canary_use_v2_4_1","state":"off","scope":"pool:canary-3"}'
```
ops-bot: Feature flag change queued. Request id ff-req-334
deploy-bot: Rolling routing: decreasing weight for v2.4.1 -> 0% in canary-3, increasing v2.4.0 -> 100%
alex: After flip, tokenization errors dropped to baseline within two minutes for affected customers. :white_check_mark:
maria: Good. We still need a full rollback or a corrected build. Proposal: rollback canary and abort region rollout, then validate tokenizer pipeline end-to-end with a few scripted prompts. Also open a PR to pin tokenizer version in manifest.
sunil: I'm taking over on-call at T+20. Handoff: current state: feature flag off for canary-3, traffic on v2.4.0, customer impact: ~7% of queries from a subset of enterprise tenants received garbled outputs for ~6 minutes before mitigation. Actions in flight: create rollback ticket, run tokenizer regression tests, verify weight artifact checksums.
sunil: Do we have a suspect cause for weights misalignment (artifact packaging step?)
maria: Likely a packaging pipeline bug that pulled tokenizer v1.2 by mistake. Build logs show tokenizers/artifact-manifest had v1.2 entry. Investigating CI step that bundles tokenizer.
jess_cs: CS note: we've notified affected customers via status page and sent templated message to accounts flagged by query anomalies. No major SLA breaches reported yet, flagging for follow-up with customers tomorrow.
maria: Raising rollback ticket: RED-ROLLBACK-20260315-1
```
- Rollback canary and pause release
- Run unit/regression tokenizer tests (priority)
- Verify checksums for weights and tokenizer artifacts
- Add manifest pin for tokenizer and validation in CI
```
maria: Assigning to eng-runtime team, tagging @sunil for on-call continuation. Leave a note here once CI root cause traced.
sunil: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate rollback verification and postmortem. Marking incident as mitigated for customer traffic. Updating incident page.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-87 status updated -> mitigated. Postmortem requested within 72h.
